info.title: Field rep app — live API only
info.seed: demo reps +963932000001 (عمر الشامي) · +963932000002 · +963932000003 — local OTP_BYPASS=true: any code verifies, rep-* clients get all zeros; production is 6 digits
info.rule: If this file and the catalog disagree, this file wins. Do not call forbidden paths. Do not mock them. App routes do not enforce rp.* permissions.

headers.Authorization: Bearer {token} — required except GET /health, GET /public/refs, GET /public/content/intro, POST /public/auth/*
headers.Accept-Language: ar — server messages may still be English; map error.code in the UI
headers.X-Device-Id: stable UUID per install — required on /public/* and /app/*
headers.X-Idempotency-Key: UUID per user intent on every write except the three public OTP paths
headers.X-Channel-Id: do not send — /app/rep sets no tenant

envelope.money: integer minor units. SYP decimals = 0 so the integer is the display amount. Never /100.
envelope.not_found: 404 means missing OR not yours — never render forbidden
envelope.permissions: session.permissions lists rp.* by kind. Routes do not check them. Do not hide screens behind can(rp.*).

forbidden.reason: Create only — no list or detail
Platform admin GET — 403 wrong_guard. The app reads GET /public/content/intro (EP-PB-011)
Platform admin write — never call from the app
Channel dashboard — 403 wrong_guard on the app
Channel dashboard write — never call from the app

gotchas: POST /app/rep/cart/lines increments qty on an existing (product, variant). Absolute qty: PATCH /app/rep/cart/lines/{id}. Remove: DELETE /app/rep/cart/lines/{id}.
POST /app/rep/customers returns RepSourcedShop id, not retailer_id. Cart, payments and submit use RetailerProfile id from GET /customers and GET /zones/{id}/shops.
Complete delivery mints receipt_no (24h). Collect with that number; a second POST /app/receipts/reserve is only for collections without a completion.
max_cash_hold 0 means no cap. cash_cap_exceeded is 403, not 423.
GET /app/rep/zones lists assigned coverage. POST /app/rep/zones still requests an extra zone.

GET /public/refs is live (governorates, zones, activity types — never channels). Bind Flutter multi-select on zones (group by governorate_id); governorate dropdown is a filter only. GET /public/content/intro is the first-run splash (same row as PUT /platform/content/intro). GET /public/app-config is live (force-update / feature flags / maintenance). supply_channel_id still has no directory.

GET /app/rep/home is the morning snapshot (EP-RP-002). Bind the six task badges from data.tasks. Do not call GET /deliveries from Home — that list materialises delivery rows. loyalty is the EP-APP-110 wallet snapshot (points 0 / bronze when empty). unread_notifications mirrors EP-CM-060 meta.unread_count. Guest has no token: 401; skip-register is local chrome with zeros.

Shared app surfaces are live: GET /app/notifications (+ read-all / clear / push-token), GET|POST /app/sync/*, GET /app/content/home-blocks, GET|POST /app/loyalty. Compose home from these — do not mock them.

endpoints.name: Health check
endpoints.description: Public liveness. No tenant, no auth.

endpoints.name: Complete rep registration
endpoints.description: Channel must be active; zones must be inside its coverage (TB-RP-010). No email field — reps authenticate by Syrian mobile only.
endpoints.note: Requires the registration-ability token from verify-otp. Response token replaces it (ability *). zones[].name is null — resolve from GET /public/refs. supply_channel_id has no directory; it comes from the channel team or an invite.

endpoints.name: App config / force-update
endpoints.description: Called on every app launch (REQ-AD-073, 074). Stale X-App-Version → 426.

endpoints.name: Request OTP
endpoints.description: purpose: register|login. Rate: 3/hour per phone, 10/hour per device, 30/hour per IP (REQ-CM-055). Phone E.164 Syrian mobile.

endpoints.name: Resend OTP
endpoints.description: prefer_channel: whatsapp|sms. Falls back to SMS if WhatsApp fails.

endpoints.name: Verify OTP
endpoints.description: 5 attempts per otp_id. New user returns is_new_user=true without a full profile.

endpoints.name: Public intro (app splash)
endpoints.description: Same singleton the platform back office edits (EP-AD-141A/B). No auth — first-run splash before OTP. Vacant store is enabled:false. Apps must not call /platform/content/intro or /channel/content/intro (wrong_guard). Targeting is ignored on first run (no zone yet). media_id is an opaque string, not a URL, until media upload exists.
endpoints.note: No auth. Same singleton PUT /platform/content/intro writes. Vacant store: enabled false, text/media null, duration 0 — that is correct, do not fake a video. Returning token skips this screen. media_id is opaque, not a URL (http → play; else assets/intro/{id}; else logo+text). Ignore targeting on first run. Do not call /platform or /channel intro (wrong_guard).

endpoints.name: Public reference snapshot
endpoints.description: Registration screens cache this locally and refresh by cursor (REQ-AD-032, REQ-CM-016).
endpoints.note: Flat arrays, not nested. Flutter dropdowns: governorates = single-select FILTER (do not POST). zones = multi-select, value=id, label=name, group by governorate_id, POST as zone_ids:[12,13] (min 1). activity_types = single-select → activity_type_id. Hide status!=active. Channels are never here.

endpoints.name: App logout
endpoints.description: Client must wipe local data (REQ-CM-056).

endpoints.name: Rep morning home
endpoints.description: Morning snapshot the home screen binds. Counts only — does not call GET /deliveries (that list materialises rows). avatar is always null until media upload. loyalty is the EP-APP-110 snapshot (points 0 / bronze when the wallet is empty). unread_notifications is meta.unread_count of EP-CM-060. collected_today is integer minor units. 401 without a bearer — guest browse is local, not a token.
endpoints.note: Morning snapshot. Bind the six task badges here — do not call GET /deliveries from Home (that list materialises rows). loyalty is the EP-APP-110 snapshot (points/tier; bronze/0 when empty). unread_notifications is meta.unread_count of EP-CM-060. collected_today is integer minor units. 401 without a bearer; guest browse is local.

endpoints.name: Update rep profile
endpoints.description: Name and phone only. avatar stays null until media upload. Phone must be unique among app users.

endpoints.name: On-duty toggle
endpoints.description: Tracking is enabled only while on duty (REQ-CM-054).

endpoints.name: App session bootstrap
endpoints.description: Called on every launch (REQ-CM-004). Distinguishes new vs returning users (TB-RT-011). requires_legal_accept blocks usage until consent (DOC-12E TB-AD-081). user.avatar is always null until media upload. Reps also receive commercial_limits and duty {on_duty, tracking_enabled}.
endpoints.note: Rep-only extras: commercial_limits, duty {on_duty, tracking_enabled}, status (profile), channel {id, name}. user.avatar is always null. max_cash_hold 0 = no cap. permissions are kind-based, not Spatie grants; routes do not check them.

endpoints.name: Show customer
endpoints.description: 404 if the shop is not sourced by this rep and not an active shop in their zones.
endpoints.note: Full shop card plus owner_name, activity_type_id, categories, equipments. 404 if not sourced and not an active shop in coverage.

endpoints.name: List customers
endpoints.description: Shops the rep sourced plus active shops in assigned zones. id is retailer_id. logo is always null. is_open is always true until a hours table exists.
endpoints.note: Paginated. Search is filter[search]. id is RetailerProfile id — this is retailer_id everywhere else. Card includes zone name, phone, address, lat/lng, logo=null.

endpoints.name: Register shop offline
endpoints.description: Stored locally and synced with a unique client_op_id (TB-RP-053). address, category_ids and equipment_ids are optional.
endpoints.note: client_op_id required; replay returns the same sourced-shop row. Returned id is NOT retailer_id — reload GET /customers. Optional address, category_ids, equipment_ids.

endpoints.name: Shops in zone
endpoints.description: Same shop card as GET /customers. is_open is always true. last_order_at is always null. logo is always null.
endpoints.note: Paginated. Search is top-level `search`, not filter[search]. Same shop card as GET /customers. is_open is hardcoded true. last_order_at is always null. 403 zone_not_covered if the zone is not assigned.

endpoints.name: Rep coverage zones
endpoints.description: Assigned zones from the rep profile. Governorate name comes from GET /public/refs.
endpoints.note: Assigned coverage: id, name, governorate_id, shops_count. Governorate label from GET /public/refs.

endpoints.name: Request extra zone
endpoints.description: DOC-12B TB-RP-055.

endpoints.name: Offer detail
endpoints.description: Re-validate via quote before submit (TB-RT-043).

endpoints.name: Browse offers
endpoints.description: company (channel identity) stays hidden until an order is confirmed (REQ-IN-06).
endpoints.note: Paginated. Empty list is valid when no offer matches the rep zone/activity/channel. company stays hidden.

endpoints.name: Server price quote
endpoints.description: Single source of truth (REQ-IN-07). Precedence stop-at-first-match (most specific wins; lists do not stack): retailer_price ← group_list ← zone_list ← qty_tier ← base_price. Clients must not send prices.
endpoints.note: Reps skip retailer visibility; still send the shop zone_id. Never send unit_price.

endpoints.name: Rep product detail
endpoints.description: Same isolation as the list. 404 if the product is not in the rep's channel.
endpoints.note: Detail plus images[] and long_description. 404 outside the rep channel.

endpoints.name: Rep catalog
endpoints.description: Union of all channels the rep belongs to. variants[] is empty when the SKU has no combinations. image is null until media is attached.
endpoints.note: Paginated. Allowed filters: filter[category_id], filter[brand_id], filter[channel_id], filter[search], barcode, zone (for price). Do not send sort, filter[offer_only], filter[available_only]. Card includes brand, image (often null), variants[].

endpoints.name: Remove shop-cart line
endpoints.description: Same cart shape as GET /cart. 404 if the line is not on this rep cart.

endpoints.name: Update shop-cart line qty
endpoints.description: Same cart shape as GET /cart. qty 0 deletes the line (same as EP-RP-026).

endpoints.name: Add line to shop cart
endpoints.description: Same shape as GET /cart. qty increments an existing (product, variant) line. PATCH/DELETE the line via EP-RP-025/026.
endpoints.note: Increments qty if the (product, variant) exists. No PATCH/DELETE.

endpoints.name: Submit shop order
endpoints.description: discount_percent must be ≤ the rep cap (BR-12).
endpoints.note: Path param is retailer_id. 403 discount_cap_exceeded if discount_percent > session.commercial_limits.max_discount_percent. note is persisted.

endpoints.name: Rep cart
endpoints.description: Grouped by shop. Lines include name from catalog snapshot.
endpoints.note: Grouped by shop. Lines include name and line_total. submit uses retailer.id.

endpoints.name: Rep submitted orders
endpoints.description: Sub-orders this rep submitted (rep_id is set on submit) or was later assigned. invoice_no is null until finance issues one.
endpoints.note: Sub-orders for this rep_id. invoice_no null until issued.

endpoints.name: Reject assignment
endpoints.description: Returns to unassigned + immediate channel alert (REQ-IN-03).

endpoints.name: Pending assignments
endpoints.description: Grouped by zone. Accept moves the card to deliveries (REQ-IN-03).
endpoints.note: Unpaginated array. invoice_no is always null. id is sub_order id.

endpoints.name: Scheduled orders
endpoints.note: Unpaginated. Query `date` (Y-m-d). shop_logo always null. id is sub_order id.

endpoints.name: Confirm handover
endpoints.description: Stock is deducted and status becomes on_the_way only when BOTH EP-WH-019 and this confirm exist (REQ-IN-02). temp_code used if previously offline.
endpoints.note: temp_code size 4. Wrong handover id → 409 illegal_transition (not 404). Replay of a confirmed handover returns the success payload.

endpoints.name: Warehouse receipts
endpoints.note: Use handover_id in the confirm path, not sub_order_id. Query `date` optional.

endpoints.name: Complete delivery
endpoints.note: 409 illegal_transition (no_handover) unless warehouse confirm ran. Mints receipt_no. ask_payment true — open collect.

endpoints.name: Adjust delivery line
endpoints.description: action: adjust|return|exchange. Updates the invoice on both sides in the same transaction (REQ-IN-05).

endpoints.name: Postpone delivery
endpoints.description: Automatically added to scheduled orders.
endpoints.note: Persists scheduled_at + reason. Card moves to GET /scheduled-orders.

endpoints.name: Delivery list
endpoints.note: Unpaginated. Delivered cards from other days are omitted. delivered count is today's delivered cards in that zone.

endpoints.name: Location pings
endpoints.description: Batched pings, on-duty only. Rate: 1/30s per rep (REQ-CM-044).
endpoints.note: 422 off_duty if not on duty. 429 rate_limited if last ping < 30s. Batch in pings[].

endpoints.name: Reserve receipt number
endpoints.description: Server-generated unique number BEFORE payment starts (REQ-IN-01). Used by EP-RP-060 then EP-RT-050.
endpoints.note: Empty body {}. Use when collecting without a completion receipt. 24h expiry.

endpoints.name: Collect payment
endpoints.description: receipt_no must be reserved first via EP-CM-050. client_op_id makes retries duplicate-safe (REQ-IN-01). invoice_no is optional — omitted, the oldest open invoice for this shop and rep is allocated FIFO.
endpoints.note: amount integer. 409 duplicate_receipt_no. 403 cash_cap_exceeded. 422 receipt_not_reserved / receipt_expired. client_op_id replay returns the same payment.

endpoints.name: Shop receivables
endpoints.description: Each by_shop row includes retailer_id (RetailerProfile id).

endpoints.name: Record cash handover
endpoints.description: operation_no comes from the accountant and must stay unique across sync retries (TB-RP-063).

endpoints.name: Wallet
endpoints.description: net_balance == SUM(collected) − SUM(settled) at all times (AC-06).

endpoints.name: Clear inbox view
endpoints.description: Clears the inbox view, not the server log.

endpoints.name: Notifications inbox
endpoints.description: meta.unread_count is included in the envelope.

endpoints.name: Sync pull
endpoints.description: Retailer scopes: catalog,pricing,offers,zones,orders,refs. Rep extra: rep_catalog,customers,zones,assignments,deliveries,wallet. If cursor is too old, full_resync_required=true.

endpoints.name: Sync push
endpoints.description: Max 500 ops per batch, 20/min per device. status: applied|duplicate|conflict|failed. Device never pushes catalog/prices/offers/stock (REQ-CM-017). Allowed: order, payment, delivery, receipt, shortage, favorite, rating, add-shop.

endpoints.name: Resolve sync conflict
endpoints.description: Client must not drop an op from the outbox until applied or duplicate (REQ-CM-019).

endpoints.name: Record banner click
endpoints.description: Atomic clicks++ on a Banner the caller can see (covering channels). Foreign or unknown id → 404.

endpoints.name: Home content blocks
endpoints.description: Filtered by the user activity type and zone, including intro targeting (TB-RT-010). Serving a Banner row increments impressions atomically.
